rows.name: Boise Bench – Midpoint #1 230kV Transmission Line Project
rows.quote:
Boise Bench – Midpoint #1 230kV Transmission Line Project
The existing 230kV #1 transmission line between Boise Bench and Midpoint will be rebuilt with
upgraded conductors to support local load growth within Idaho Power’s Treasure Valley Region.
rows.in_service_raw: between the end of 2024 and the end of 2029

rows.name: Boise Bench 230kV Shunt Capacitor Project
rows.quote:
Boise Bench 230kV Shunt Capacitor Project
Due to increasing local loads in Idaho Power’s Treasure Valley Region the need was seen to add
additional shunt capacitance at the Boise Bench 230kV substation.

rows.name: Boise Bench Generation Project
rows.quote:
Boise Bench Generation Project
The Boise Bench BESS Generation Project (BOBS) at the existing Boise Bench 138 kV
substation located near Boise, ID is a 150 MW inverter-based battery generation resource.

rows.name: Pleasant Valley Solar 2 Generation Project
rows.quote:
Pleasant Valley Solar 2 Generation Project
The Pleasant Valley Solar 2 Generation Project (PVS2) at the existing Pleasant Valley Solar
(PVSR) 230 kV substation located near Boise, ID is a 125 MW inverter-based solar generation
resource.

rows.name: Happy Valley Generation Project
rows.quote:
Happy Valley Generation Project
The Happy Valley BESS Generation Project (HVBS) at the existing Happy Valley 138 kV
substation located near Nampa, ID is a 80 MW inverter-based battery generation resource.

rows.name: Kuna Generation Project
rows.quote:
Kuna Generation Project
The Kuna BESS Generation Project (KUBS) at the existing KUNA 138 kV substation located
near Kuna, ID is a 150 MW inverter-based battery generation resource.

rows.name: Blacks Creek Generation Project and Blacks Creek Substation
rows.quote:
Blacks Creek Generation Project and Blacks Creek Substation
The new Blacks Creek substation (BSCR) is being built south of Boise,ID to interconnect the
Blacks Creek Generation Project.

rows.name: Boardman to Hemingway Transmission Project
rows.quote:
Boardman to Hemingway Transmission Project
The Boardman to Hemingway Transmission Line Project (B2H) is a planned 500-kilovolt (kV)
transmission project that would span between the Hemingway 500-kV substation near Melba,
Idaho, and the proposed Longhorn Substation near Boardman, Oregon.

rows.name: Midpoint-Kinport 345 kV Series Capacitor Addition
rows.quote:
This includes two system
upgrade projects identified to reinforce Borah West and Midpoint West.
• Midpoint-Kinport 345 kV Series Capacitor Addition
• Midpoint 500/345 kV Second Transformer Addition

rows.name: Midpoint 500/345 kV Second Transformer Addition
rows.quote:
This includes two system
upgrade projects identified to reinforce Borah West and Midpoint West.
• Midpoint-Kinport 345 kV Series Capacitor Addition
• Midpoint 500/345 kV Second Transformer Addition

rows.name: Gateway West Transmission Project
rows.quote:
Hemingway substation near Boise, Idaho. Current permitting and pre-construction activities are
focused on the section of line between Hemingway and Midpoint substations. Idaho Power
expects the in-service date for this section of line, or a portion of this section, will be 2028 or
later.

rows.name: Mayfield (MYFD) 500kV substation
rows.quote:
Mayfield (MYFD) 500kV substation:
A new 500kV substation MYFD has been proposed by Idaho Power to connect on the
second 500kV circuit from Midpoint to Hemmingway Gateway West Section. The
resulting lines will be an approximate 36 mile Hemmingway-Mayfield 500kV, and an
approximate 90 mile Mayfiled-Mipoint 500kV line.

rows.name: Pallette Junction Station Project
rows.quote:
Pallette Junction Station Project
The new 230kV Pallette Junction substation (PLJN) is planned to be installed north of
Oxbow,OR as a switching station near the intersection point of three existing 230kV lines in the
area: Wala-Hurricane-Hells Canyon 230kV, Lolo-Imnaha-Oxbow 230kV, and Brownlee-Hells
Canyon 230kV.
